contract.canonical_type: logical C++ value or void result and async effect; private physical ABI returns objc3::task<R>
contract.entry: lazy frame; explicit executor or actor root start; nested private child inherits current parent destination
contract.await: queued suspension; continuation published after active callback returns; sticky executor/actor destination through yield and dependencies
contract.hops: same-actor, shared-executor and cross-worker hops; executor destination clears actor identity
contract.dispatch_failure: closed/full mailbox or executor and cancelled queued actor job terminalize as cancellation with exactly-once frame cleanup
contract.pending_waits: runtime executor callbacks return NOT_READY for pending task waits and group joins, regardless of current task destination
contract.cleanup_isolation: resume segments use the mailbox; completion observers and forced cleanup retain existing public task callback rules
contract.cancellation: cooperative; leaving private-child await cancels unfinished child; shared task_handle dependency remains independent
contract.cleanup: native frame, aligned locals/results, deferred statements, Objective-C objects, Blocks and captured exceptions
contract.interfaces: PCH and canonical semantic imports preserve logical effect identity; immutable source-free provider consumption
contract.abi_cutover: all objects, PCH files, semantic interfaces and packages require rebuild
contract.sanitizer_limit: runtime services and clients instrumented; GNU libobjc loaded as shipped, not instrumented
reserved: direct Objective-C object and Block results

interrupted_candidate.reason: Stop before archive publication to fix atomic coalescing of deferred and concurrent resume requests

native_validation.scope: Native Clang foundation checks; feature claims follow schemas/objc3-language-capabilities.json.

installed_source_modules.limits: Example module graph, not a general package manager. Build timings exclude full SDK admission and final verification; elapsed timings include both. The native linker runs on every invocation.
